entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you please provide me with your full name or order number?
Yes, it's under Sarah Miller. The whole process is just a bit much for me.

Okay, I see your account, Sarah. Thank you for being one of our VIP members. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 22nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine! It's... well, it was a bit of an impulse buy for my new year's resolution. I just... I changed my mind. I honestly don't use it, and I feel bad just having it sit there. Can't you just help me? I couldn't figure out the return page.
Of course, I can help you, Sarah. No need to worry. So it's not a defect, you'd just prefer to return it. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Thank you, I'd really appreciate that.
Okay, one moment... Right, I'm looking at your order date and our policy here. It shows that we have a 90-day return window for items in their original condition.
That's correct. Your delivery was only 17 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe. We can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you so much, David.

It's my pleasure. And as a valued VIP member, I've gone ahead and made sure your return shipping label is completely free of charge. I'm emailing that to you now. Just print it out, place the VeloBand back in its box, and drop it off at any post office.
You've made this so easy. Thank you, thank you!
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
